targets.old_statement: Forward gas rescues only a side or rear threat with open road ahead, everywhere else the triad ranks stopping and turning first, and speed as the rare third door.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Forward gas rescues only a side or rear threat with open road ahead, everywhere else the triad ranks stopping and turning first, and speed as the rare third door.
targets.statement: To avoid a collision, drivers have three options—stop, turn, or speed up—and speeding up may be best or necessary when another vehicle is about to hit from the side or behind and there is room ahead to escape danger, slowing down once danger passes.
